description.value: Through a subtle attunement to the Force, you learn two force powers of no higher level than your Max Power Level (per the scout table); they count as tech powers for you but don't count against your Powers Known total. You learn two more at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level, and whenever you gain a level in this class, you may swap one known force power for another of no higher level than your Max Power Level.
